components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button. Indigo fill, white text, gentle radius, press animation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.55 0.24 275); color: oklch(0.99 0 0); font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0 0.625rem; height: 2rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.55 0.24 275 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.55 0.24 275); outline: 3px solid oklch(0.55 0.24 275 / 0.5); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent fill, border, muted hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.16 0.01 280); font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0 0.625rem; height: 2rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.91 0.01 280); border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.955 0.01 280); color: oklch(0.16 0.01 280); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.55 0.24 275); outline: 3px solid oklch(0.55 0.24 275 / 0.5); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Standard text input. Transparent background, border, indigo focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.16 0.01 280); font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.91 0.01 280); border-radius: 0.75rem; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.50 0.01 280); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.55 0.24 275); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.55 0.24 275 / 0.5); }

components.name: Selection Control
components.description: Grid-based toggle button for settings. Replaces radio groups and selects throughout the app.
components.css: .ds-selection-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-selection-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid oklch(0.91 0.01 280); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.50 0.01 280); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-selection-item:hover { border-color: oklch(0.50 0.01 280 / 0.5); background: oklch(0.955 0.01 280 / 0.3); } .ds-selection-item.ds-selected { border-color: oklch(0.55 0.24 275); background: oklch(0.55 0.24 275 / 0.05); color: oklch(0.55 0.24 275); } .ds-selection-item:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview:
Quiet power under the hood. The interface is calm, measured, and restrained — the AI does the heavy lifting. Every surface exists to get out of the way and let the generated content take center stage. The system uses a single indigo accent as its voice: present enough to guide, rare enough to matter.

The palette is built entirely in OKLCH, giving consistent perceptual lightness across light and dark modes. Both themes share the same hue channel (275°) with chroma and lightness shifted to maintain contrast. Cards float on a near-white or deep-charcoal ground. Typography pairs geometric Sora for headings with humanist Outfit for body — a technical-meets-approachable pairing that reads as modern without being cold.

Density is medium. Cards carry generous internal padding (1rem), sections are spaced with 1.5rem gaps, and the main content column is capped at max-w-4xl (56rem). Interactions are refined and restrained: subtle border shifts on hover, gentle press animations (scale(0.97)), and staggered fade-in-up entrance animations that unfold the page progressively.
keyCharacteristics: Single-accent indigo system with OKLCH color space
Refined, restrained interactions — no bold hover effects or dramatic state changes
Content-forward: generated captions and images are always the visual protagonist
Staggered entrance animations create a sense of progressive disclosure
Consistent card-based layout across all app pages

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the only chromatic color in the system. Every other color is a tinted neutral. This constraint keeps the interface quiet and lets generated content remain the visual focus.

rules.name: The Heading Font Rule
rules.body: Only h1–h6 and elements with font-heading use Sora. Everything else uses Outfit. No exceptions, no mixing within a text block.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: App surfaces are flat at rest. The single hover shadow on the landing page is the exception, not a pattern to extend. State changes use border color, background tint, and opacity — never elevation.

dos: Do use oklch for all color definitions — the entire palette is in OKLCH.
Do use the selection control pattern (grid of toggle buttons) for any new setting with 2-8 discrete options.
Do add stagger classes (stagger-1 through stagger-8) to page sections for progressive entrance animation.
Do keep the content column at max-w-4xl with consistent horizontal padding across breakpoints.
donts: Don't introduce a second chromatic accent.
Don't add box-shadows to app UI cards or surfaces.
Don't use Lucide, Heroicons, or any icon library other than @phosphor-icons/react.
Don't use hex or hsl colors — all tokens are oklch.
Don't add gradient text to any element.
